text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Known-answer test: a permanent step of 10% or 25% of a Primary's load was added to 14 Primaries at four onsets (200 worlds); scored over the first 90 days after the step. Line: 95% interval from resampling the four onsets. Dashed rule: same as equal weights.'
